test_bbd_direct_sum.claim: Rf_*(IC(X)) decomposes as ⊕_k ^pH^k(Rf_*IC)[-k], direct sum with no ext¹

test_semisimple_summands.claim: Each ^pH^k in decomposition is semi-simple: ⊕_i IC(Z_i, L_i)

test_blowup_formula.claim: Rf_* Q_{Bl_p(X)} ≅ Q_X ⊕ Q_p[-2] for blowup of point

test_hard_lefschetz.claim: Hard Lefschetz: L^k: IH^{3-k}(X) → IH^{3+k}(X) isomorphism for projective 3-fold

test_decomp_filtration_unsat.claim: Decomposition must be direct sum; claimed as filtration with unsplit extensions

test_nonsemisimple_unsat.claim: Semi-simplicity violated: claimed Ext¹ nonzero for summand

test_lefschetz_violation_unsat.claim: Hard Lefschetz violated: L^1 not isomorphism (rank mismatch)

test_boundary_identity_map.claim: Identity map f=id: X→X gives Rf_*IC = IC(X) (trivial decomposition)

test_boundary_smooth_fibration.claim: For smooth f: X → Y, Rf_*IC decomposes via tensor product with fiber cohomology

test_boundary_normal_crossing.claim: Blowup of normal crossing divisor decomposes as sum of IC on components
